product_title: Red & Gold Floral Diya Holders with Pearl and Crystal Accents
product_description: Add a touch of festive elegance to your home with this beautiful pair of floral diya holders. Featuring rich red petals, golden detailing, pearl borders, and sparkling crystal accents, they are perfect for Diwali pooja, festive table décor, and traditional celebrations.
product_care_suggestion: Wipe gently with a soft, dry cloth.
Avoid water, harsh chemicals, and abrasive cleaners.
Handle pearls and crystal embellishments carefully.
Store in a cool, dry place after use.
